SFS-STN-CLD-LH-001.name: Liquid Hearts
SFS-STN-CLD-LH-001.elasticStretch: Stretches approximately up to 12 inches, loops 2-3 times comfortably around the neck of your ponytail.
SFS-STN-CLD-LH-001.description: Remember when everything had hearts, glitter and personality? Liquid Hearts brings that iconic era back—wrapped in buttery Luxe Satin. #ManeCharacterEnergy
SFS-STN-CLD-LH-001.washcare:
HOW TO KEEP YOUR GEAR FRESH ?

Hand Wash Only: Treat it like the premium gear it is. Dip in cool water with a drop of mild shampoo.

No Heat, No Stress: Never iron or blow-dry. Air-dry in the shade to keep the colors "funky."

The Bounce Back: If it loses volume, give it a gentle steam from a distance to bring back the "jumbo" ruching.

Hustle Proof: Built to stay secure, but avoid using sharp pins near the fabric to prevent snags.
